name: high-school-timetable
title_zh: 早读午休晚自习值班表，从排班本和规则文件里生成
tagline_zh: 排班本翻到哪页排到哪页，规则文件说哪天就哪天。早读、午休、晚自习值班，一次排清，不再对着Excel数人头。
tagline_en: Turn appointment workbooks & rule docs into complete duty rosters for morning reading, quiet study & evening.
desc_en: Use when generating or revising a Chinese high-school timetable or its early-reading, quiet-study, and evening-study duties from appointment workbooks and rule documents.
why_zh: 它读的是排班本和规则文件，不是让你重新录入。规则里写『单周周三』它就认单周周三。
why_en: It parses your existing duty books & rule files—no re-entry. Change a rule like 'odd-week Wed' in the doc, not across cells.
limit_zh: 只认中文高中课表场景：早读、午休、晚自习三类值班。输入必须是排班本（.xlsx/.csv）和规则文件（.md/.txt…
limit_en: Chinese high-school only: morning-reading, quiet-study, evening-study duties. Inputs: duty workbook (.xlsx/.csv) + rule file (.md/.txt). Outputs.
title_en: Generate high-school timetables from duty books & rules
